title: Admissions open for academic year 2083
excerpt: Applications are now open for Nursery to Grade 10. Apply online or visit the school office.
body: The School of STEAM Education is now accepting applications for the academic year 2083 for Nursery through Grade 10.

Families can apply online through our website in about ten minutes, or visit the school office any school day between 9 AM and 3 PM. The attached guidelines explain eligibility, required documents and important dates.
Seats in early grades are limited. We encourage families to apply early and to book a campus visit — we would love to show you how our students learn.

title: First terminal examination routine published
excerpt: First terminal examinations run 24–30 August. The full routine is attached.
body: First terminal examinations for all grades will run from 24 to 30 August. The complete routine, including reporting times and seat plans, is attached as a PDF.
Class teachers will review the routine with students this week. Please make sure your child rests well and arrives fifteen minutes before each paper.

title: Dashain & Tihar holiday schedule
excerpt: The school will remain closed for the festive season. Classes resume after Tihar.
body: The school will remain closed for the Dashain and Tihar festive season according to the published academic calendar.
We wish every family a joyful and safe festival. Classes resume on the first working day after Tihar; the exact dates are marked in the school calendar.
